## Mission Statement

ETechProvider was founded to make enterprise-level digital capability accessible and affordable for UK small and medium-sized businesses. The agency operates as a full-stack digital partner — handling web engineering, organic search growth, paid media, content, and cloud infrastructure under one roof.

## Full Service Catalogue

### Web Development
- Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, WordPress
- Pricing: From £499 (Starter) | £999 (Growth) | £2,499+ (Scale/Enterprise)
- Timeline: 2-8 weeks depending on complexity

### Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Includes: Technical SEO audit, on-page optimisation, keyword research, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, backlink strategy, local SEO, monthly reports
- Pricing: From £299/month (retainer) | From £199 (one-off audit)

### Social Media Marketing
- Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X (Twitter)
- Includes: Content calendar, branded graphics, caption writing, scheduling, community management, analytics
- Pricing: From £399/month

### Paid Advertising (PPC)
- Platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads
- Includes: Campaign strategy, creative production, A/B testing, conversion tracking, monthly reporting
- Pricing: From £299/month management fee + ad spend

### UI/UX Design
- Tools: Figma, Adobe XD
- Includes: Wireframing, high-fidelity UI design, design system, prototype, accessibility review (WCAG 2.1)
- Pricing: From £799 per project

### Cloud Infrastructure
- Platforms: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure
- Includes: Server provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, database management, 24/7 monitoring
- Pricing: From £999 per project

### E-Commerce Development
- Platforms: WooCommerce, Shopify, custom Next.js e-commerce
- Includes: Product catalogue, payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal), POS integration, inventory management, CRO
- Pricing: From £799

### AI Integration
- Technologies: OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, LangChain, Python
- Includes: AI chatbots, content generation pipelines, recommendation engines, RAG systems
- Pricing: From £1,299 per project

## 5-Step Process

1. Discovery — Understand client goals, competitors, audience, and define scope of work
2. Strategy — Technology selection, content plan, SEO keyword mapping, project milestones
3. Design — Wireframes and high-fidelity Figma UI designs with client review and iteration
4. Build — Development, QA testing across devices/browsers, staging environment review, go-live
5. Grow — SEO campaigns, paid advertising, social media, A/B testing, monthly analytics reviews

---

## Technology Stack

Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vue.js
Backend: Node.js, Python, PHP, Django, Laravel
CMS: WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Contentful, Sanity
Cloud: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions
AI: OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Anthropic Claude API, LangChain, Pinecone
Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs
Design: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop
Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Redis, Supabase
